title: Build versioned ground-truth benchmark corpus
description: Starts NOW in parallel with DATAP-c7dd46 (evaluator foundation). Applies the completed curation skill from DATAP-9179d1. Convert the useful research corpus into a production benchmark with pinned repository commits and explicit complete-file or complete-directory annotation scopes. Store positive, negative, ambiguous, and unread states with provenance and review status. Every scanner finding inside an exhaustively annotated scope must match positive ground truth or count as a false positive. Internal parallelism: different repositories can have annotation packets prepared independently; humans can review independently; repo discovery continues while first repos are annotated. Sequential boundary: final benchmark serialization must follow shared identity/evidence conventions once DATAP-c7dd46 contract stabilizes; ground-truth labels require human approval before acceptance. Keep runtime cloning out of normal CI; provide a reproducible materialization or cached-fixture workflow for the benchmark.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Parallel start: this task begins now alongside DATAP-c7dd46 (evaluator foundation), not after DATAP-9179d1. Curation skill from DATAP-9179d1 is already complete and applied here. Once benchmark cases are available, they supply real evaluation inputs to DATAP-d61496 and DATAP-f3feec — a dotted dependency only; those adapters can start after c7dd46 without waiting on this benchmark.
